headlines.title: Engram is a sampler that turns broken AI hallucinations into music
headlines.summary: Music startup Thoughtful Things has just launched the Kickstarter campaign for its first instrument, Engram. It's a sampler and groovebox that uses AI to mangle incoming audio and even hallucinate completely new sounds.

concept.title: Tokens & Context Windows
concept.body: Models read and bill in 'tokens' (word fragments), and a 'context window' caps how much they consider at once. Bigger context lets you feed more, but cost and latency rise with it.
concept.takeaway: Watch cost-per-task, not just cost-per-token — verbose prompts add up fast.
